professionalSummary.text: Operates Elasticsearch or OpenSearch clusters running on Kubernetes.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran four OpenSearch clusters on Kubernetes at Quillmark, a code-hosting company, handling node-pool upgrades and shard rebalancing during maintenance windows.

experienceHighlights.text: Improves query latency and shows the result as percentiles over fixed windows before and after the change.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reduced p99 latency of the code-search query service from 2.4 seconds to 0.9 seconds, comparing the two weeks before with the two weeks after the switch to per-repository routing in May 2023.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Keeps a high-volume indexing pipeline reliable, including back-pressure and retry handling.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Added back-pressure to the indexing workers so that large repository imports paused queue consumption instead of overloading the clusters, with retries capped at five attempts.

skills.text: Writes capacity plans for search clusters covering compute, memory and storage.
skills.witness: Drafted the 2024 storage forecast for the search clusters from twelve months of index-growth data; the infrastructure lead reviewed it before the hardware order.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with OpenSearch clusters on Kubernetes, query latency improvements, indexing pipeline reliability, and capacity planning. They do not establish the candidate's current Kubernetes certification.

evidence.text: Ran four OpenSearch clusters on Kubernetes at Quillmark, a code-hosting company, handling node-pool upgrades and shard rebalancing during maintenance windows.
Reduced p99 latency of the code-search query service from 2.4 seconds to 0.9 seconds, comparing the two weeks before with the two weeks after the switch to per-repository routing in May 2023.
Added back-pressure to the indexing workers so that large repository imports paused queue consumption instead of overloading the clusters, with retries capped at five attempts.
Drafted the 2024 storage forecast for the search clusters from twelve months of index-growth data; the infrastructure lead reviewed it before the hardware order.

Recruiter verification: the candidate's Certified Kubernetes Administrator certificate (number CKA-2306-118842) was checked on the issuer's online verification tool on 2 October and is shown as active through August 2026.
